reviews.reason: Safe for this unit only. Printed p.66/PDF104 matches the supplied Geʽez, including ኵኵሕ, singular ቈላ, and final ። before XXVII. The baseline asterisk precedes the second አንከርኩ; raised 18 and 19 are apparatus references, not source text. English preserves all three expressions of wonder and the final intensification. Facing PDF103 ends within 26:4 and supplies no Greek text for 26:6. No chapter approval is implied.
reviews.suggested_text: And I marveled at the rocks, and I marveled at the valley, and I marveled greatly.[a]
reviews.footnote_changes: Clarify that “ravine” is a translation alternative, not a variant reading: [a] The singular landscape term translated “valley” can also be rendered “ravine.” The threefold expression of wonder is retained.
